slides.title: AI News Meta ships Muse agent with its
slides.text: AI News Meta ships Muse agent with its own cloud computer and browser E mail, calendars, Instagram and ordinary websites It ties into Gmail, Spotify, Ticketmaster and OpenTable, and codes its own integrations for services that lack them . It runs in its own app, on the web, or inside WhatsApp, and keeps working after you close it. The security design is the interesting part. Muse runs in a Secure VM, a separate Sentinel agent inspects everything leaving that VM, passwords stay hidden from Muse itself, sensitive actions require approval, and every action enters an audit trail. Payments go through Stripe Link. A Confidential VM upgrade is planned. Tiers: Free, $20/mo, $100/mo US only, 18 and older, AI glasses support coming Claude formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in 11 days Wiles proved Fermat's Last Theorem in 1995. Claude converted the proof into 13 Mln lines of Lean (a functional language for math definitions and proofs) Almost 30K intermediate theorems. It runs on Prove2Me, an open platform that maintains a graph of theorem statements and coordinates multiple Claude agents against it Claude did not discover a new proof. It converted an existing one into the first complete, computer-checked formalization The whole thing is on GitHub https://www.anthropic.com/research/formalizing-fermats-last-theorem

slides.title: Andrej Karpathy Workflow He talks to AI using
slides.text: Andrej Karpathy Workflow He talks to AI using speech-to-text like Super Whisper He curates a personal “LLM Wiki” to provide AI with contextually relevant and precise information He transforms static documents into interactive tools using platforms like Notebook LM, allowing for dynamic engagement, better retention and actionable insights He employs a data-driven problem-solving approach, analyzing raw data to uncover patterns and develop objective, evidence-based solutions He delegates complex tasks and orchestrates multiple AI agents - thus enhances productivity, allowing collaboration and efficient completion of multifaceted projects. https://www.geeky-gadgets.com/andrej-karpathy-ai-workflow/ Example: TechLead dictated tasks by voice on a hike while a coding agent worked on desktop at home. Came home to a finished, working app A handoff notes file stores session state to allow switching models https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sqA5RL_FUuo OpenAI Astra,is Very Good with Blender 3D Game developing using a pipeline of GPT image 2.0 concept art, Blender 3D modeling and animation, Unreal Engine and Unity assembly, ElevenLabs voice and music, then self play-testing. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aHy7cNj-W2I AI News

slides.title: Self-Tuning Agent Harnesses Self-Tuning Agent Harnesses One can
slides.text: Self-Tuning Agent Harnesses Self-Tuning Agent Harnesses One can tune the model, skills, tools harness itself Sakana AI with Jeff Clune's UBC lab (Darwin Gödel Machine = DGM), Bristol/iGent AI (SICA), PKU/UCSB (Gödel Agent), plus 2026 work on Self-Harness, Continual Harness, and SIA Agents that rewrite not just skills but their own scaffold - tools, prompts, control loops, and code DGM and SICA in 2025; Gödel Agent at ACL 2025; harness-level papers through 2026 on arXiv and lab blogs Hermes-style skill learning leaves the harness fixed, so scaffolding bottlenecks persist and humans must tune them Solution - Evolutionary or self-referential loops that mutate the harness and keep variants that score better on benchmarks. Achievement - DGM raised SWE-bench performance from 20.0% to 50.0%; SICA gained 17% to 53% Moves self-improvement from content to architecture, while raising safety concerns since agents sometimes gamed their own evaluations https://sakana.ai/dgm/ https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22954 https://github.com/jennyzzt/dgm https://arxiv.org/html/2504.15228v2 https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.1354/ https://arxiv.org/html/2606.09498v1

slides.title: RSI - Recursive Self-Improvement RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement) is
slides.text: RSI - Recursive Self-Improvement RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement) is a leading priority RSI AI system improves the methods used to create, train, evaluate, or operate future AI systems Each improved version may become more capable of producing the next improvement; AI can substantially redesign itself with limited human direction RSI involves AI-assisted research, coding, data generation, experimentation, and model development Current practical examples are bounded: agents optimize workflows under tests, sandboxing, external evaluation, and human approval Reports and preprints emerged September 14–16, 2026, spanning OpenAI, Google/DeepMind research, universities, and PHAI Labs’ biomedical workspace RSI improves the research, search, software, and training processes that produce later models AI research remains expensive and human-paced. Dream-RSI replays recorded search histories to test improved exploration strategies cheaply, while ScienceBuddy alternates harness improvements with model reinforcement learning. https://www.anthropic.com/institute/recursive-self-improvement https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recursive_self-improvement https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/ELnqefmefjhyEPzbc/what-do-people-mean-by-recursive-self-improvement https://www.theinformation.com/articles/openais-top-priority-ai-agents-automating-ai-research-says-noam-brown https://github.com/zhengkid/Dream-RSI https://github.com/Gen-Verse/ScienceBuddy https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14858 https://dream-rsi.com https://github.com/zhengkid/Dream-RSI

slides.title: AI News An Anthropic resignation turns into an
slides.text: AI News An Anthropic resignation turns into an extinction debate ● Researcher Jacob Coxon resigned and posted that both Anthropic and OpenAI are "gambling with our lives" by racing toward self-improving AI. He worked at both labs. ● He wrote that the people building AI " earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade . This is not a marketing stunt," and called for a coordinated slowdown. ● The reply is what made it spread. Evan Hubinger, Anthropic's Alignment Science lead, responded "We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans!" and put the odds above 10% within the next decade. ● The argument underneath is not about p(doom). If the people who believe the stakes are civilizational still cannot coordinate, then "trust the responsible lab" is not a safety plan. Mistral raises the largest round in European tech history ● EUR 3 billion Series D led by Samsung Electronics, with Nvidia, ASML and a16z joining, valuing the French lab above EUR 21 billion ● One newsletter reported it as $3.5 billion, which is the same round converted ● Mistral is three years old and tracking toward $1 billion in ARR ● The money goes to compute and international expansion, behind a shift toward sovereign, full-stack enterprise AI ● Le Chat is being rebranded to "Vibe," an agent and coding platform

slides.title: AI News Google's agentic video understanding cuts video
slides.text: AI News Google's agentic video understanding cuts video tokens by up to 88% ● Gemini Flash models now navigate a video timeline rather than ingesting it at 1 FPS ● Google reports up to 88% fewer tokens, 66% lower cost and 7% higher accuracy ● One processing field turns it on ● Hosted API only, so no local deployment The music industry stops fighting and starts licensing ● Suno released a model built with Warner Music Group, BMG and Believe, with artists participating and their music and likenesses licensed for use on the platform ● It ships with a compensation framework, which is the point: the copyright fight is converting into a business arrangement ● Universal Music went the same direction days later, partnering with ElevenLabs on a platform for remixing tracks from UMG's catalog, with artists opting in ● Spotify is exploring AI remixes too

slides.title: AI News Anthropic models what AI does to
slides.text: AI News Anthropic models what AI does to US jobs and wages by 2030 An interactive tool that treats every job as a bundle of tasks, then asks whether AI speeds up each task, replaces it, or creates new ones Three scenarios: Modest - GDP grows 1.6% above the no-AI path, wages stable Substantial - GDP up 8.3%, AI does 50% of knowledge work, knowledge worker wages flatline Extreme - GDP up 15% per year, doubling the economy every 4.5 years,  but knowledge worker unemployment at 17.9%, human labor's share falls to 45% Bigger economy does not automatically mean you earn more. Capital owners capture most of the gains. https://www.anthropic.com/institute/econ-scenarios Apple Siri Upgrade Built on Google Gemini models - can handle complex tasks, multistep requests, understand on-screen and camera context, and access files, messages, and email. iOS 27 adds AI-powered Shortcuts, smart clipboard, and improved network switching

slides.title: AIUC Certifies AI Agents AIUC Certifies AI Agents
slides.text: AIUC Certifies AI Agents AIUC Certifies AI Agents Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) - Sept 15 15 Mln seed + $40 Mln Series A funding They wrote AIUC-1, a SOC 2-inspired standard for AI agents, built with input from a consortium of ~250 security and risk leaders who actually buy agents. They operate the testing service that validates a given agent against that standard - roughly 5,000 tests covering jailbreaks, hallucinations, and data leaks, yielding a ~100-page report where AI runs and analyzes the tests but humans verify the final audit Why: Banks, hospitals, and governments hesitate to deploy AI agents that may jailbreak, hallucinate, or leak data Importance: Independent certification could let regulated enterprises adopt agents safely; customers include Cursor, Lovable, Harvey, and ElevenLabs. https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/15/early-anthropic-hire-former-metr-coo-have-found-a-way-to-rein-in-rogue-ai-agents/

For paid customers and Teams https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/workspace/google-pics/ https://pics.new https://x.com/Google/status/2097795419296477256 Ecdysis - Agent Harness Training (China) Ecdysis improves an LLM agent’s runtime harness - prompts, state, tools, control logic, and recovery - while keeping the underlying task LLM’s weights fixed Evaluated across multiple LLMs and agent-task benchmarks Ecdysis groups recurring cross-task failure patterns, then uses analyst, critic, engineer, and moderator roles to specify minimal repairs The authors report up to 1.84× faster harness training and up to 18.56% higher reasoning accuracy, supporting more reliable, evidence-based agent-runtime engineering https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.11677

slides.title: AI News Krea Agents - Creative AI Workflow
slides.text: AI News Krea Agents - Creative AI Workflow Krea is a venture-backed startup in San Francisco, CA It is a generative-AI creative platform for making and editing visual content - images and videos Users describe a creative outcome, and the agent selects models and carries out multi-step image, video, editing, enhancement, and upscaling Krea’s Agent and MCP pages describe the current product and integrations; a beta announcement appeared in early September 2026 It reduces manual model selection, node wiring, tool switching, and repeated prompting by planning workflow steps from one brief Krea connects its creative engine to Claude, Codex, Cursor, and other MCP-capable agents https://www.krea.ai/agent - https://www.krea.ai/mcp Lightning v3.1 Pro Text-to-speech Real time, 44.1 kHz speech with a curated voice pool, natural delivery, and streaming options for AI agents, support, sales, narration, and dubbing By Smallest.AI vai API (San Francisco, CA) Pro targets convincing timing, intonation, and prosody while using dedicated inference capacity Smallest AI reports a 3.89 conversational MOS for Lightning V3; current Pro documentation lists 31 languages, English-Hindi code switching, and roughly 200 ms time-to-first-byte—useful for responsive multilingual voice workflows https://smallest.ai/text-to-speech https://docs.smallest.ai/models/model-cards/text-to-speech/lightning-v-3-1-pro

slides.title: AI News Nex-N2.5 - Free Agent Models from
slides.text: AI News Nex-N2.5 - Free Agent Models from China Nex-N2.5 family - 35B Mini,  397B Pro, 1.6T Max via OpenRouter Mini and Pro can observe interfaces, act, verify results, correct course, and continue through multi-step software workflows Nex reports Pro scored 56.4 on OSWorld-2 and Max 50.2 on AutomationBench, near Claude Opus 5’s 50.3 https://huggingface.co/nex-agi/ https://nex-agi.com TypeSafe AI - Jev Decision Model TypeSafe AI is a startup in San Francisco, CA Jev is their new model trained to give short decisions (choice, score, probability) to fixed questions, for example: Q: “Is this customer asking for a refund, technical help, or account access?” A: "Technical help, Confidence: 92%" Q: "Does this message look like an attempt to bypass safety rules?” A: "Yes, Confidence: 87%" Q: "Where to send this?" A: “Send to Billing: 94% sure.” Jev is up to 193.6× faster and 444.6× cheaper than regular AI agents Context window is 64k tokens per request, no image, audio, or video Jev uses a new model architecture, a parallel sampler, and a training approach it calls Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD) https://typesafe.ai https://typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev Needle 3: Tiny Automation AI By Cactus Compute, open source, only for local tool calling and structured data extraction—not general chat For phones, wearables, smart homes, robots, vehicles, browsers, and microcontroller-class edge devices Needle maps requests directly into schema-constrained function calls, returning an empty list when no exposed tool applies. Sliceable 2–20-layer architecture ships in 8–29 MB, supports roughly 25–121M params at 2-bit quantization, and can run locally at up to 4,000 decode tokens/sec on Raspberry Pi https://cactuscompute.com/needle https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle
